name: card-remover
author: BlaXun
description: A Card Remover in Prontera, Geffen, Alberta, Morroc, Payon, Izlude and Al De Baran takes one card out of the equipment you are wearing -- the item and the card both survive. He is paid in cards, not zeny: every card is worth points by its tier, and the cost depends on the tier of the card you free. Pick the card and your payment in his window.
